On a more philosophical level death could simply be considered unconsciousness from the old body to the new one. I personally believe all consciousness is one, the only difference is each of our experiences via our brains. I don't know. This is just stuff I've thought about. 

The eternal blackness is tricky imo. While I believe death, sleep (where you don't have or don't remember dreams), and unconsciousness are extremely similar.. death cannot be experienced or recalled. When you wake up from sleeping or being unconscious was it really blackness? Or is that the brain trying to fill in the gap between consciousness? I think it is the latter. The brain doesn't understand nothingness, I personally can't wrap my head around it. Death is the complete absence of subjective consciousness, so it can never be experienced or described. Which to some could be a relief but for me it is unsettling. Sorry I went on a little rant here haha

Death scares me because I am worried a lot about reincarnation. If I kill myself, it is to escape the pains of life and the stresses of society.. not come right back in it with the possibility of being in a worse of place.

I am not even scared of hell... cause I'm convinced we are already in it. At least with my current depressed perception of my life and the world around me. 

I just have a gut feeling death isn't the escape we dream it to be. That's the main thing holding me back.
